# Implementation Plan: Capture, persist, display & replay Claude chain-of-thought over Copilot /chat/completions
<!-- ralph-meta {"overviewTaskId":"codex-anthropic-chat-reasoning-text-capture-and-replay"} -->


*Generated by `/plan-with-ralph` on 2026-06-21. Ready for `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan .ralph/jobs/codex-anthropic-chat-reasoning-text-capture-and-replay/plan.md`.*

## Overview

The fork's anthropic-models support already GENERATES and BILLS Claude chain-of-thought (CoT) on every turn over the Copilot `/chat/completions` transport — Copilot streams it as a non-standard `choices[].delta.reasoning_text` field (gated by `reasoning_effort`) — and then DISCARDS it at deserialization. This plan makes that CoT (1) captured off the wire, (2) displayed live, (3) persisted to the rollout/history, and (4) replayed back onto later-turn requests so Claude retains its prior reasoning across turns.

The split is deliberate: **capture + persist + display is CORE-ONLY** (extending the already-fork-exclusive D-001 `core/src/chat_transport*` module; the overlay parser is untouched), while **replay is an OVERLAY change** (`codex-copilot/src/payload.rs`) treated as a scoped D-001 exception. This is the **unsigned/plaintext continuity path**; the fully-faithful signed-thinking native-Messages transport is a SEPARATE task (`codex-anthropic-native-messages-transport-for-signed-cot`) and is explicitly out of scope here. An early probe-extension de-risk story decides the replay field shape before any overlay code is written.

## Research Findings

### Codebase Context

Target tree: codex submodule at `D:/harness-efforts/codexu/codex`. Overlay crates: `codex-rs-overlay/codex-copilot/`. Patched upstream core: `external/repos/codex-patched/codex-rs/`. Rust workspace; build/test via `just` (`just fmt`, `just test -p <crate>` → `cargo nextest run`); typecheck gate `cargo check --workspace` (~6 min). `cargo test --workspace` is CI-only.

**Wire shape (operator-verified live probe at `D:/ExtRepos/copilot-thinking-probe/probe.mjs`, re-confirmed against the 0.141 tree during planning):** reasoning chunks are
`data: {"choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"content":"","reasoning_text":"Let","role":"assistant"}}],...}`
— `delta.content` is the EMPTY STRING (not null, not an array) and `delta.reasoning_text` carries the CoT chunk. 46 reasoning_text chunks at `reasoning_effort="high"`; ZERO with no effort. Reasoning precedes content + tool_calls. NO signature.

**Drop points (both parsers drop it today):**
- Overlay `codex-rs-overlay/codex-copilot/src/chat_completions.rs:156-178` — `ChatDelta` deserializes only `content` + `tool_calls`; serde drops `reasoning_text`. `decode_chunk` (120-152) only emits `ContentDelta` when content is non-empty, so the `content:""` reasoning chunk yields NOTHING from the overlay parser.
- Core `external/repos/codex-patched/codex-rs/core/src/chat_transport/anthropic_sse.rs:237-295` — `decode_openai_structured_content` early-returns unless `delta.content` is an array, so the string-empty reasoning chunk is skipped. (The same file's `thinking_delta`/`signature_delta` handling at `:174-176` is DEAD CODE for this endpoint — Copilot returns OpenAI chat SSE, never Anthropic Messages SSE.)

**Capture/persist/display types already exist (NO new types needed):**
- `codex-api/src/common.rs:73-114` — `ResponseEvent::{OutputItemAdded, OutputItemDone, ReasoningContentDelta{delta, content_index}}`.
- `protocol/src/models.rs:927-940, 1518-1523` — `ResponseItem::Reasoning{summary, content: Option<Vec<ReasoningItemContent>>, encrypted_content, ..}` and `ReasoningItemContent::ReasoningText{text}`.
- `protocol/src/protocol.rs:1836-1845` — `ReasoningRawContentDeltaEvent.content_index: i64`.

**Mirror pattern (assistant-message lifecycle):** `core/src/chat_transport.rs:87-134` `AssistantMessageItem` (`open()`→OutputItemAdded(Message), `finish()`→OutputItemDone(Message)); `:185-330` `run_chat_stream` fans bytes to BOTH parsers; `:338-361` `handle_translated_events`; `:366-447` `handle_event`; `:521-595` regression test proving open-before-text + close-with-full-text (the lifecycle-test model).

**Consumer / display (NOT gated by `supports_reasoning_summaries`):** `core/src/session/turn.rs:2050-2121` makes an `OutputItemAdded` item the active item; `:2275-2294` handles `ReasoningContentDelta` only when an active item exists, else `error_or_panic("ReasoningRawContentDelta without active item")` — so the reasoning item MUST be opened before any reasoning delta, exactly like the existing `OutputTextDelta without active item` guard (`:2217-2219`).

**Replay flow (CONFIRMED end-to-end — a persisted Reasoning item reaches `push_chat_message`):** history accepts Reasoning (`core/src/context_manager/history.rs:445-466`) → `parse_turn_item` preserves `ReasoningText` (`core/src/event_mapping.rs:139-185`) → `build_responses_request` serializes `input` (`core/src/client.rs:774-830`; chat dispatch arm `:1672-1708`) → `build_chat_request_body` → `push_chat_message` (`codex-rs-overlay/codex-copilot/src/payload.rs:251-325`). The ONLY place reasoning is dropped on the chat path is `push_chat_message`'s `_ => {}` arm (`:322-325`). `should_serialize_reasoning_content` (`protocol/src/models.rs:1255-1262`) serializes the `content` field whenever it holds a `ReasoningText`, so the reasoning survives into history.

### Technical Constraints

- **Engineering tenants (`codex/CLAUDE.md`):** minimize upstream-canonical conflict surface; every `// SANDBOX PATCH:` edit pairs with a `docs/implementation/patch-surface.md` §14 invariant row + §15 replant note. **Both halves extend EXISTING fork-exclusive D-001 files** (`chat_transport.rs:1` is already a D-001 SANDBOX PATCH module; `anthropic_sse.rs:1` is a D-001 module; `payload.rs:1` is the D-001 overlay). So NEITHER half adds a NEW inline upstream-canonical edit — the patch-surface work is *extending* existing D-001 invariants, and the "scoped overlay exception" is about the D-001 INTERNAL boundary (capture deliberately stayed core-only), not about upstream churn.
- **Gate is inherent:** capture runs only inside `run_chat_stream`, reached only on the ChatCompletions wire, already gated by `anthropic_models_resolved()` (Feature::AnthropicModels; `model-provider/src/anthropic_gate.rs:35-45`) via `effective_wire_api` (`chat_transport.rs:63-75`). No new gate is added; the plan states the inherent gating.
- **reasoning_effort default = medium** (task `codex-knob-a-default-medium`, threaded explicitly to the chat path at `client.rs:1690-1700`): CoT is present by default, so capture fires by default. The capture must behave correctly at every level including a future `none` (zero reasoning_text chunks ⇒ NO reasoning item opened).
- **Model-visible context rules (`external/repos/codex-patched/AGENTS.md`):** no history rewrite, bounded items, avoid cache-miss churn. Replayed reasoning is model-visible history and must respect this.
- **Change-size guidance:** under 800 (ideally 500) lines per coherent stage. Capture is additive/localized; replay is small.
- **Two-commit submodule flow (for impl, not this plan):** commit inside the codex submodule first, then bump the codexu pointer.

## Approach

### Architecture

Add a core-owned `TranslatedSseEvent::ReasoningDelta(String)` (core-owned **by design: the capture half must keep the overlay's `ChatStreamEvent` UNTOUCHED**, so the reasoning variant lives on the core-owned `TranslatedSseEvent`, not on the overlay enum. NOTE: a neutral `ReasoningDelta(String)` *could* technically live on `ChatStreamEvent` and be mapped in core's `handle_event` without the overlay depending on `codex-api` — so the justification is the core-only-capture constraint, not a hard Cargo-cycle limit) and a reasoning-item accumulator that mirrors `AssistantMessageItem`, emitting the standard reasoning lifecycle: open with `OutputItemAdded(Reasoning{summary:vec![], content:None, encrypted_content:None, ..})` on the first delta → per-chunk `ReasoningContentDelta{content_index:0}` → close with `OutputItemDone(Reasoning{content:Some(vec![ReasoningText{text}]), encrypted_content:None, ..})` — all BEFORE the assistant message. The accumulator MUST be threaded into BOTH `handle_translated_events` (where `ReasoningDelta` arrives) AND the content/tool close path so it closes on the first `ContentDelta` **and** the first `ToolCallDelta` (tool-only turns produce no assistant text) and at stream finish if still open. Live display and rollout persistence then fall out of the existing item handling for free. For continuity, extend the overlay `push_chat_message` to map a persisted `ResponseItem::Reasoning` back onto the chat request in the field shape the endpoint honors (decided by the probe), with inline plaintext as a guaranteed fallback. **Forward-compatibility (cross-task insurance for the future signed-CoT fast-follow):** the persisted shape is left signature-ready — `ResponseItem::Reasoning` already carries an `encrypted_content: Option<String>` field, which is exactly where a future signed/encrypted-thinking variant would live. The unsigned path sets `encrypted_content: None` today, but US-002/US-003 must NOT hard-code an assumption that precludes a later `Some(signature)` (i.e. capture/persist/replay key off the `content: [ReasoningText]` plaintext and must not, e.g., reject or strip a populated `encrypted_content`). No signature is built now; this is purely shape-neutrality so the signed fast-follow (`codex-anthropic-native-messages-transport-for-signed-cot`, which touches the SAME two files) needs no persistence rework.

### Implementation Strategy (ordered)

1. **US-001 (de-risk, FIRST):** extend the probe to a 2-turn request to decide the replay field shape. Output is a decision record consumed by US-003. May run in parallel with US-002.
2. **US-002 (core capture/persist/display):** parser decode + reasoning-item lifecycle + tests + patch-surface update. Independent of US-001.
3. **US-003 (overlay replay):** `push_chat_message` reasoning arm in the decided field shape + round-trip test + patch-surface update. Depends on US-001 (field shape) and US-002 (something must be captured/persisted to replay).

## Scope

### In Scope
- Capture `choices[].delta.reasoning_text` off the Copilot chat SSE (core-only).
- Display it live via the existing reasoning event/UI path (not gated by `supports_reasoning_summaries`).
- Persist it to the rollout/history as `ResponseItem::Reasoning{content:[ReasoningText]}`.
- Replay a persisted reasoning item back onto later-turn chat requests (overlay, scoped exception) in the probe-decided field shape, plaintext, with a bounded-size cap so replayed reasoning never exceeds the fork's model-visible-context bound.
- Parser unit tests, lifecycle/ordering tests (reasoning→content AND reasoning→tool-call), a persistence test, a replay round-trip test, an end-to-end persisted→request-body test, a bounded-history cap test, and an `encrypted_content` forward-compat test.
- patch-surface.md invariant + replant updates for both seams.
- Probe extension (2-turn input-acceptance de-risk).

### Out of Scope
- The signed/verified-thinking native Anthropic Messages transport (`codex-anthropic-native-messages-transport-for-signed-cot`).
- Any change to the `/responses` transport path.
- Any TUI redesign of reasoning rendering (the existing rendering is reused as-is).
- A user-facing config toggle for capture/replay (capture is inherently anthropic-gated; no new gate).

## Risk Areas

- **Ordering (HIGH):** the reasoning item MUST be opened before any `ReasoningContentDelta` (else `error_or_panic`) and CLOSED before the assistant `Message` opens (since `OutputItemAdded(Message)` replaces the active item at `turn.rs:2050`/`:1957`). The close trigger must fire on the first content event **and** the first tool-call event (tool-only turns produce no assistant text — a reasoning item left open when a `FunctionCall` item arrives would leave the wrong active item) AND at stream finish if still open with no content/tool. Concretely, the `ReasoningMessageItem` accumulator must be threaded into BOTH `handle_translated_events` (open + stream deltas) and `handle_event` (close-before `ContentDelta`/`ToolCallDelta`) plus the post-loop finalize — it is easy to close for `ContentDelta` but miss `ToolCallDelta` or the translated-event path. The `:521-595` regression test is the model for asserting order; tests must cover BOTH reasoning→content and reasoning→tool-call.
- **Bounded plaintext-reasoning history (HIGH):** replayed reasoning becomes model-visible history, and history truncation currently clones `ResponseItem::Reasoning` UNCHANGED (`core/src/context_manager/history.rs:445-466`). The fork's "model visible context" rules (`external/repos/codex-patched/AGENTS.md`) require bounded items and **no item >10K tokens**. Plaintext CoT can be large (the probe captured 46 chunks for a trivial question), so unbounded replay risks oversized, cache-busting, or context-bloating items. US-002/US-003 must adopt a bounded strategy — e.g. cap/truncate the replayed reasoning text to a documented size, and/or only replay the most-recent turn(s)' reasoning — with a regression test feeding a large reasoning item and asserting the cap is enforced. This is the main correctness/repo-invariant risk beyond ordering.
- **Double-emit (cleared, must be tested):** the reasoning chunk carries both `content:""` and `reasoning_text`. The overlay parser drops it (empty content); core `decode_openai_structured_content` is the only emitter; later string-content chunks stay on the overlay parser. A test must assert exactly one `ReasoningDelta` per chunk and no double-emit.
- **Replay field shape UNDECIDED + accepted≠honored (de-risked by US-001):** `reasoning_text` field on the assistant message vs. inline plaintext content. CRITICAL distinction (reviewer consensus): a `/chat/completions` endpoint can ACCEPT an unknown field (HTTP 200) while silently IGNORING it — acceptance is not the same as the model HONORING the reasoning as continuity. So US-001 must check both (a) transport acceptance (HTTP 200, not a 400 field-rejection) AND (b) at least a qualitative signal that turn-2 output reflects the replayed reasoning. If semantic honoring cannot be demonstrated for the unsigned plaintext path, the feature is HONESTLY framed/downgraded as **"model-visible plaintext context injection (best-effort continuity)"**, NOT verified reasoning replay — the fully-faithful honored path is the separate signed task. If the probe is inconclusive or the endpoint rejects the `reasoning_text` field with HTTP 400, US-003 falls back to inline plaintext (always accepted), so US-003 is never blocked.
- **Replay attach-vs-standalone:** `push_chat_message` is stateless and item-by-item (`payload.rs:277`), and a reasoning item PRECEDES its assistant message in the `input` array. Default: emit reasoning as a **standalone assistant-role message** (keeps `push_chat_message` stateless — the simplest correct shape). If the probe shows the endpoint requires the reasoning ATTACHED to the following assistant message, that needs buffering/merge logic in the caller loop at `payload.rs:257-261` (hold the reasoning item, attach it when the next assistant `message` is built); US-003 names this as the attach-path implementation. US-001 probes both; US-003 implements the honored shape with standalone as the default.
- **Context stability / cache (MEDIUM):** replayed reasoning is model-visible history — must not rewrite older items, must stay bounded (see the bounded-history risk above), and should avoid cache-miss churn. A round-trip test plus a manual 2-turn smoke validate the turn still completes and tools still work.
- **Unsigned/plaintext (accepted):** no signature; best-effort echo, not verified CoT. Documented, not fixed here (the signed path is the separate task).
- **Persistence-shape forward-compatibility (MEDIUM — cross-task insurance):** the future signed-CoT fast-follow (`codex-anthropic-native-messages-transport-for-signed-cot`) would touch the SAME two files (core `anthropic_sse.rs` + overlay `payload.rs`). The persisted `ResponseItem::Reasoning` shape must stay neutral/extensible so that fast-follow can populate the existing `encrypted_content: Option<String>` field with a signature WITHOUT reworking persistence. Concretely: set `encrypted_content: None` for the unsigned path, but never strip/reject a populated `encrypted_content` on capture or replay, and don't add logic that assumes reasoning is always plaintext-only. No signature is implemented now.
- **reasoning_effort=none:** zero chunks ⇒ no reasoning item; a test asserts this.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC1: A parser unit test in `anthropic_sse.rs` feeds a `reasoning_text` chat-SSE fixture (with `delta.content:""` + `delta.reasoning_text`, mirroring the captured probe SSE) and asserts exactly one `TranslatedSseEvent::ReasoningDelta` per chunk, in order, with text concatenating to the expected CoT.
- AC2: A test asserts the overlay `ChatSseParser` emits NOTHING for the same `content:""`+`reasoning_text` chunk (no double-emit across the two parsers).
- AC3: A transport test asserts the emitted `ResponseEvent` order for a reasoning-then-content turn is: `OutputItemAdded(Reasoning)` → one or more `ReasoningContentDelta{content_index:0}` → `OutputItemDone(Reasoning{content:[ReasoningText{..}], encrypted_content:None})` → `OutputItemAdded(Message)` → `OutputTextDelta` → `OutputItemDone(Message)`.
- AC4: A test asserts that with zero `reasoning_text` chunks (reasoning_effort=none shape), NO reasoning item events are emitted.
- AC5: A persistence assertion: the closing `OutputItemDone(Reasoning)` yields a `ResponseItem::Reasoning` whose `content` holds a `ReasoningItemContent::ReasoningText` (so `should_serialize_reasoning_content` serializes it into history).
- AC6: US-001 produces a written decision record committed to a named artifact `.ralph/jobs/codex-anthropic-chat-reasoning-text-capture-and-replay/probe-decision.md` (and the captured 2-turn raw SSE/response evidence) that states: (a) which candidate replay field shape(s) Copilot `/chat/completions` ACCEPTS on input (HTTP 200 vs a 400 field-rejection), exercising an explicit, recorded request body for each candidate (`reasoning_text` field on the assistant message vs. inline plaintext content vs. standalone assistant message); and (b) whether turn-2 output shows any qualitative sign the replayed reasoning was HONORED (continuity), or an explicit statement that honoring could not be demonstrated — in which case the feature is framed as best-effort plaintext context injection (see Risk Areas). "Accepted" and "honored" are reported separately.
- AC7: A replay round-trip test in `codex-copilot` feeds a `ResponseItem::Reasoning{content:[ReasoningText{text}]}` through `push_chat_message` and asserts the emitted chat message carries the reasoning in the decided field shape (or the inline-plaintext fallback), and that non-reasoning items are unaffected (unchanged).
- AC8: `cargo check --workspace` passes, run FROM `external/repos/codex-patched/codex-rs`.
- AC9: Run FROM `external/repos/codex-patched/codex-rs`: `just test -p codex-core` and `just test -p codex-copilot` pass, including all new tests. (The `justfile` lives at `external/repos/codex-patched/codex-rs/justfile`; `cargo test -p codex-core` / `cargo test -p codex-copilot` are the equivalent if `just` is unavailable in the impl environment.)
- AC10: `codex/docs/implementation/patch-surface.md` (the canonical ledger) has a new/updated §14 invariant row + §15 replant note for the capture seam (US-002) and the replay exception (US-003); each new edit inside the D-001 files carries an inline `// SANDBOX PATCH: D-001 reasoning capture|replay` marker.
- AC11: The capture path adds NO new gate; the plan/PR notes the inherent `anthropic_models_resolved()` gating and the `reasoning_effort=medium` default interplay (`codex-knob-a-default-medium`).
- AC12: The persisted shape stays signature-ready and is verified by a concrete test: feed a `ResponseItem::Reasoning{content:[ReasoningText{text}], encrypted_content:Some("sig")}` through `build_chat_request_body`/`push_chat_message` and assert (a) no panic, (b) the plaintext reasoning still replays in the decided shape, and (c) the original input item is NOT mutated. This proves US-002/US-003 add no plaintext-only assumption that would preclude a future signed `encrypted_content: Some(..)`.
- AC13: Bounded plaintext-reasoning history is enforced: a regression test feeds an oversized reasoning item (well beyond the documented cap) and asserts the replayed reasoning is capped/truncated (or the bounded-replay policy — e.g. most-recent-turn-only — is applied) so no replayed item exceeds the fork's model-visible-context size bound. The chosen cap/policy is documented in the plan/PR and in `patch-surface.md`.
- AC14: A transport ordering test covers the reasoning→**tool-call** path (reasoning chunks followed by `tool_calls`, no assistant text): asserts the reasoning item is opened then CLOSED (`OutputItemDone(Reasoning)`) BEFORE the `FunctionCall` item is finalized, so `session/turn.rs` never sees a tool/function item while the reasoning item is still the active item.
- AC15: An end-to-end (integration-style) test or fixture proves the full persisted→replay path in sequence: `OutputItemDone(Reasoning)` → rollout/history → `build_responses_request` → `build_chat_request_body` → `push_chat_message` yields a chat request body carrying the reasoning. (Stitches AC5 persistence and AC7 replay into one path so neither side can pass while the join is broken.)

## Preliminary Story Decomposition

- **US-001** — Probe 2-turn input-acceptance de-risk (decides replay field shape). External `probe.mjs`; no codex-source edits. Small.
- **US-002** — Core capture/persist/display: `ReasoningDelta` decode + reasoning-item lifecycle in `chat_transport` (closing on content AND tool-call, threaded into both `handle_translated_events` and `handle_event`) + parser/lifecycle/persistence tests (reasoning→content AND reasoning→tool-call) + patch-surface update. Medium.
- **US-003** — Overlay replay: `push_chat_message` reasoning arm in the decided shape (standalone default; attach-path buffering named if probed) + bounded-replay cap + round-trip/e2e/encrypted_content-forward-compat tests + patch-surface update. Depends on US-001 (field shape) and US-002 (captured items to replay). Medium.
